_comment: External-1 and External-2 are the two external evaluations frozen before annotation. This file records exactly what can and cannot be regenerated, because the honest answer differs between the two halves of the pipeline.

regenerable.unit_construction: yes - data_preprocessing/external/driver.py rebuilds the claim-cutoff units from the released unit files
regenerable.reannotation: yes for the retained retrieval texts - data_annotation/external/annotate_external.py

NOT_regenerable.retrieval: The External-1/2 PubMed query strings were never released, so the retrieval cannot be re-run from the query forward. data_preparation/03_reretrieve_audit.py marks them non-regenerable by design.
NOT_regenerable.text_reading_methods: The external corpora ship as unit-level label counts without record identifiers, so text-reading methods cannot be evaluated on them. This is what restricts text-reading methods to checks 1-4 in the paper's protocol.
NOT_regenerable._consequence: Population alignment was established (identifier sets and pre/post-cutoff record counts match the original retrieval for all 46 External-1 and 180 External-2 claims), which is not the same as identical input text. Metric replay remains distinct from text-dependent re-execution.
